# CustomGrabPose

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Interaction/CustomGrabPose.cs#L9)

Marks up one way of holding an object: where the hand attaches and which pose it takes. Sits on
a child of the grabbable so scripts can read the pose without digging through the hierarchy.
